# Crowbar (`equipment:crowbar`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 2 gp | **Weight:** 5 lb.

Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.
